name: landing_page
description: Landing V3: classify family → section thesis → tokens → paint → observe → review → subtraction
when_to_use: Landing page / 落地页 / 官网 / website / marketing page / homepage hero — multi-section web layout (not resume, not pure poster)
prompt_negative: Never default to Hero + 3 cards + 3 cards + Logo + CTA. Classify family first. Do not invent logos, pricing tiers, or testimonials. Do not paint a festive poster unless the user asked.

zh-CN.description: 落地页 V3：先判品类，再按章节论点绘制，禁止三卡片默认模板

en.description: Landing V3: classify family, then section thesis — never the 3-card default
